description: Pages losing clicks between two equal windows (28 or 90 days, versus the previous window or the same window last year), each labeled by cause: decayed-content means position held and the content aged (refresh it), ranking-drop means position fell and a refresh will not fix it. Rows are ordered by clicks lost and capped; counts always cover the full evaluated set, steady rows are excluded from the list. Live GSC read on paid plans, daily-capped. Requires the audit:read scope.
name: get_gsc_decay
title: Content decay pages with cause labels
